top_choice_rationale: P001 awards the GLP-1 and incretin-therapy discovery to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The arc from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect to the identified active peptide and receptor biology is original and mature. It is confirmed by large independent trials of glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. Each of the three has a distinct, documented part of the discovery core, so the allocation and the citation scope are clean. No award is the only alternative on the slate and would withhold a well-established achievement.
